q: How does a Jaipur bearing maker count the steel it buys in its footprint?
title: Jaipur bearing maker steel Scope 3
short: Put purchased bearing steel, tubes and rings in Scope 3 category 1, at the supplier's figure per tonne or a stated default. Add your own heat treatment fuel and electricity in Scope 1 and 2. Bearings are not CBAM goods, but buyers ask for footprints.
audience: Bearing manufacturers in Jaipur and their component suppliers

ul: Bar, tube or forged rings bought in, by weight.
Supplier figure per tonne, or a default with its source.
Scrap sold from turning reduces nothing in Scope 3 but is worth recording.
Electricity for turning, grinding and assembly.
Gas or electricity for heat treatment furnaces.

p: Divide by bearings made, weighting by mass if sizes differ.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
